top_choice_rationale: P001 is a mature, independently confirmed discovery chain, from proglucagon processing and human incretin physiology through the active GLP-1(7-36/37) peptide and receptor biology to therapies whose benefit in glycaemia, weight and cardiovascular and renal outcomes is shown in large randomized trials. Drucker, Holst and Mojsov cover distinct discovery contributions inside the three-person cap, and a citation anchored in the physiology and active peptide, saying these made the therapies possible, credits the chain without claiming the drug design. The weaknesses are Mojsov's contested priority against Habener's group and the omission of Knudsen, but these do not outweigh the achievement, so awarding it is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; past postdoctoral work with Paul Greengard and co-authored dopamine-neuron works with committee member Thomas Perlmann involve no credited name in P001
